batch10_adjacent_recheck.reason: Batch 10 implemented accepted-output ownership, bounded complete-capture scope, and one-TextOutput ownership/back-reference checks only. It did not implement multi-item occurrence semantics, streaming event/drop/app-stop semantics, error-to-output mapping, parse-failure handling, or chunk-retention semantics. Partial prim.model.output support therefore does not satisfy these dependency surfaces.

model_partial_lifecycle.new_surface: one partial-output lifecycle predicate family: an accepted application-visible ModelOutput with incomplete response and partial capture remains valid across timeout/interruption; partial capture itself is a valid core representation

model_completion_axes.reason_separate: Requires a two-ModelOutput cross-occurrence predicate proving response_termination and capture_extent are independent; not the same predicate as partial-output retention.

provider_failover.new_surface: positive failover orchestration plus per-attempt provider/effective-model/effective-request metadata correlation and no-inference behavior

source_redirect.new_surface: redirect preservation and redirect-not-alias on a not-yet-started prim.source.observation executor

source_occurrence_version.new_surface: repeat-observation occurrence identity and external-version-hint non-identity on a not-yet-started prim.source.observation executor

selection_analysis.selection_reason: The selected three-case model-output cluster has the strongest combined leverage and implementation reuse after Batch 10. It extends the existing model_output_executor with one coherent partial-output lifecycle predicate family. Provider failover is only two cases across two receipts and requires two broader orchestration/metadata surfaces. Source clusters have better file density but would open a new primitive executor. OUT-030 and the other remaining model-output cases are deliberately excluded because they require separate predicates.

intent: Select only OUT-009, OUT-010, and OUT-027 for Batch 11. Do not register or execute them in this selection commit. OUT-011, OUT-030, OUT-034, OUT-047, provider failover, source observation, ordering/time, and all Batch-10-adjacent cases remain fail-closed.
